deferred_follow_up: Single-session cumulative byte-ceiling enforcement has real mutation evidence, but complete cumulative exfiltration resistance remains DEFERRED-FOLLOW-UP. The conformance test admits a session at 900 of 1000 bytes and denies one at 1200 of 1000 bytes using the production SessionJournal and DataFlowGuard. It does not aggregate across sessions or processes, measure semantic information density, account for compression ratios, or prove classification-appropriate limits are enabled. Follow-up work must add principal-wide durable accounting, session-churn resistance, semantic or classified-data budgets, compression-aware measurement, and deployment configuration evidence.
